general_information.Description: This course develops students’ teamwork and workplace communication skills for academic and professional contexts. Students examine how teams function and practice building trust, leadership, and conflict management while communicating effectively in collaborative settings. The course also emphasizes academic integrity, netiquette, and ethical communication as essential principles for responsible participation in academic and professional communities. Through group projects and applied activities, students develop practical skills in writing, presentations, meetings, and career communication.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final examination. - Students are responsible for completing all exercises, assignments, and lab work assigned by the instructor, whether in class or at home, and for submitting them on time. - Laptops may be used in class for learning purposes only. - Promptly access the FLM system at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.
general_information.Note: Progress marks: - 01 Participation: 10% - 02 Activities: 10% - Project: Part 1: 10% (Project Proposal & Presentation) Part 2: 20% (Group Project Deliverables & Final Project Report/Presentation) - 01 Quiz: 5% - 02 ASM: 20% - 01 Final exam: 25% Conditions to pass: Final exam >= 4 Grade Average >= 5/10

description: This course develops students’ teamwork and workplace communication skills for academic and professional contexts. Students examine how teams function and practice building trust, leadership, and conflict management while communicating effectively in collaborative settings. The course also emphasizes academic integrity, netiquette, and ethical communication as essential principles for responsible participation in academic and professional communities. Through group projects and applied activities, students develop practical skills in writing, presentations, meetings, and career communication.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain key concepts of teamwork, leadership, and team dynamics in academic and workplace contexts.
Apply teamwork and leadership skills to accomplish group tasks and projects effectively.
Demonstrate effective communication in collaborative settings using emotional intelligence and meeting facilitation techniques.
Analyze and resolve team conflicts using problem-solving and constructive feedback strategies.
Produce professional written documents and deliver clear and persuasive presentations for academic and workplace purposes.
Develop a personal career plan and demonstrate readiness for professional environments.
Demonstrate ethical and responsible communication in teamwork and professional contexts.
